mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cargo ( booking_id, shipper_id, booking_status, transport_status, routing_status, cargo_type, weight_kg, spec_origin_unlocode, spec_destination_unlocode, spec_arrival_deadline, booking_amount_value, booking_amount_currency, hazmat_un_code, hazmat_hazard_class, hazmat_packing_group, temp_min_celsius, temp_max_celsius, temp_unit, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{bookingId}, #{shipperId}, #{bookingStatus}, #{transportStatus}, #{routingStatus}, #{cargoType}, #{weightKg}, #{specOriginUnlocode}, #{specDestinationUnlocode}, #{specArrivalDeadline}, #{bookingAmountValue}, #{bookingAmountCurrency}, #{hazmatUnCode}, #{hazmatHazardClass}, #{hazmatPackingGroup}, #{tempMinCelsius}, #{tempMaxCelsius}, #{tempUnit}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT id, booking_id, shipper_id, booking_status, transport_status, routing_status, cargo_type, weight_kg, spec_origin_unlocode, spec_destination_unlocode, spec_arrival_deadline, booking_amount_value, booking_amount_currency, hazmat_un_code, hazmat_hazard_class, hazmat_packing_group, temp_min_celsius, temp_max_celsius, temp_unit, tracking_number, created_at, updated_at FROM cargo WHERE booking_id = #{bookingId}

SELECT id, booking_id, shipper_id, booking_status, transport_status, routing_status, cargo_type, weight_kg, spec_origin_unlocode, spec_destination_unlocode, spec_arrival_deadline, booking_amount_value, booking_amount_currency, hazmat_un_code, hazmat_hazard_class, hazmat_packing_group, temp_min_celsius, temp_max_celsius, temp_unit, tracking_number, created_at, updated_at FROM cargo ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE cargo SET booking_status = #{bookingStatus}, routing_status = #{routingStatus}, tracking_number = #{trackingNumber}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
